summary: The RC5 evidence is not release-valid for reviewed commit 24b9ef27. Validation and all retained evidence manifests identify commit 35396b0e, and the checkout is detached with untracked audit-run files.

evidence: audits/evidence/v571_rc5_candidate/stages/visual_evidence_manifest.json:4-5 records pipeline hashes associated with the 35396b0 generation.
audits/evidence/v571_rc5_candidate/provenance/acceptance_provenance_manifest.json:120-156 records replay artifacts but contains no reviewed-commit identity matching 24b9ef27.
The validation receipt and retained manifests therefore do not establish that the artifacts were generated from the requested reviewed commit.
git status --short --branch reports detached HEAD and untracked audits/runs/20260827-v571-remediation-acceptance-rc5/.
audits/agent_charters/repository_release.md:8-11 requires recording and reconciling branch, commit, remote, upstream, status, diff scope, ignored artifacts, and version-consistent audit decisions.
audits/evidence/v571_rc5_candidate/report/01_biological_results/data/report_consistency_validation.json:2-10 reports pass and confirms source CSV, Excel, and PDF contract agreement.
audits/validation/v571_35396b0_validation.md:19-31 records passing validation commands, but those commands are explicitly tied to 35396b0e rather than reviewed commit 24b9ef27.

findings.title: Acceptance evidence is bound to a different commit
findings.impact: The required repository-release claim cannot be accepted because the validation receipt and retained RC5 manifests prove execution and provenance for 35396b0e, not for reviewed commit 24b9ef27.
findings.recommendation: Regenerate or formally rebind all required validation and evidence manifests on reviewed commit 24b9ef27, rerun the required audit gate, and archive a superseding acceptance run.

findings.title: Reviewed checkout is detached and not clean
findings.impact: Release provenance is not recoverable as a clean branch state, and the requested audit-run directory is untracked.
evidence: git status --short --branch reports ## HEAD (no branch) and ?? audits/runs/20260827-v571-remediation-acceptance-rc5/.
git branch -vv reports the reviewed commit on detached HEAD; no upstream is associated with the reviewed checkout.
findings.recommendation: Perform the release audit from a clean, explicitly identified branch or immutable commit checkout, record upstream/push state, and ensure the final audit record is intentionally archived without unrelated untracked content.

findings.title: Claim registry still points to a blocked prior audit
findings.impact: The claim metadata does not document a passed superseding decision for RC5.
evidence: audits/claims_registry.json:62-65 records latest_audit run_id 20260827-v571-remediation-acceptance-rc4 with gate_passed false and decision blocked_pending_remediation.
findings.recommendation: After independent reviews pass, record a new append-only audit decision for RC5 and update the claim registry through the repository's audit workflow.

limitations: No full-stack inference or new audit-gate execution was performed, per instruction.
No other review outputs were read.
recommended_follow_up: Re-run validation and provenance checks on commit 24b9ef27e9a3b602e037acc5995030cbbf496788.
Regenerate every retained manifest whose generation commit is 35396b0e.
Repeat the complete independent audit gate and archive the superseding decision.
